"use client";

// Pull-to-search (Saša, 2026-09-22: "make the search open with a drag down,
// refresh-like, like iOS — exaggerated and with a nice animation so it does
// not look like a bug"). Phones only. Dragging the page down from its very
// top pulls the content along with resistance and reveals a ring that fills
// with the pull; once the ring is full it turns solid, the label flips to
// "Release to search", and letting go opens the global search palette. A
// short pull springs back and does nothing. The numbers live in
// src/lib/pull-to-search.ts.
//
// The gesture is decided with touch events (not pointer events) because
// only touchmove can cancel the browser's own overscroll — iOS rubber-banding
// and Chrome's pull-to-refresh — for the duration of OUR pull.

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { openCommandPalette } from "@/components/shell/command-palette";
import { SearchIcon } from "@/components/ui/search-input";
import { useDict } from "@/i18n/client";
import {
  isPullArmed,
  pullIntent,
  pullOffset,
  pullProgress,
  type PullIntent,
} from "@/lib/pull-to-search";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Phones and tablets in the drawer layout (below lg) with a touch screen. */
const MOBILE_QUERY = "(max-width: 1023px) and (pointer: coarse)";
const RING_R = 15;
const RING_C = 2 * Math.PI * RING_R;
const SPRING = "transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.2, 0.36, 1)";

export function PullToSearch() {
  const t = useDict();
  const indicator = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const ring = useRef<SVGCircleElement>(null);
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false);
  const [pulling, setPulling] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const content = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-pull-content]");
    if (!content) return;
    const media = window.matchMedia(MOBILE_QUERY);

    let startX = 0;
    let startY = 0;
    let intent: PullIntent | "idle" = "idle";
    let travel = 0;
    let wasArmed = false;

    const paint = (offset: number, progress: number) => {
      content.style.transform = offset ? `translate3d(0, ${offset}px, 0)` : "";
      const el = indicator.current;
      if (el) {
        // The pill rides in the gap the content opens; fully visible after
        // the first ~40px of travel, scaling up as it goes.
        const visible = Math.min(1, travel / 40);
        el.style.opacity = String(visible);
        el.style.transform = `translate3d(-50%, ${offset - 48}px, 0) scale(${0.85 + 0.15 * visible})`;
      }
      if (ring.current) {
        ring.current.style.strokeDashoffset = String(RING_C * (1 - progress));
      }
    };

    const settle = () => {
      content.style.transition = SPRING;
      content.style.transform = "";
      const el = indicator.current;
      if (el) {
        el.style.transition = "transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.2, 0.36, 1), opacity 200ms ease";
        el.style.opacity = "0";
        el.style.transform = "translate3d(-50%, -48px, 0) scale(0.85)";
      }
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        content.style.transition = "";
        if (el) el.style.transition = "";
      }, 380);
    };

    const reset = () => {
      intent = "idle";
      travel = 0;
      wasArmed = false;
      setArmed(false);
      setPulling(false);
    };

    const ignoredTarget = (target: EventTarget | null) => {
      if (!(target instanceof Element)) return true;
      // Overlays own their touches; form controls too. A scrolled inner
      // scroller (a sheet body, a wide table) is not "the top of the page".
      if (target.closest("dialog[open], [role=dialog], input, textarea, select, [contenteditable], [data-pull-ignore]")) return true;
      let node: Element | null = target;
      while (node && node !== document.body) {
        if (node.scrollTop > 0) return true;
        node = node.parentElement;
      }
      return false;
    };

    const onStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (!media.matches || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
      if (window.scrollY > 0 || ignoredTarget(e.target)) return;
      startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      intent = "undecided";
      travel = 0;
      wasArmed = false;
    };

    const onMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (intent === "idle" || intent === "not_a_pull") return;
      const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - startX;
      const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
      if (intent === "undecided") {
        intent = pullIntent(dx, dy);
        if (intent !== "pull") return;
        setPulling(true);
        content.style.transition = "";
        if (indicator.current) indicator.current.style.transition = "";
      }
      if (window.scrollY > 0) {
        // The page scrolled under us (momentum) — not a pull any more.
        intent = "not_a_pull";
        paint(0, 0);
        reset();
        return;
      }
      // Ours now: no rubber-band, no native pull-to-refresh.
      e.preventDefault();
      travel = Math.max(0, dy);
      const nowArmed = isPullArmed(travel);
      if (nowArmed !== wasArmed) {
        wasArmed = nowArmed;
        setArmed(nowArmed);
        // A tick under the thumb where the platform offers one (Android).
        if (nowArmed && "vibrate" in navigator) navigator.vibrate?.(8);
      }
      paint(pullOffset(travel), pullProgress(travel));
    };

    const onEnd = () => {
      if (intent !== "pull") {
        reset();
        return;
      }
      const open = wasArmed;
      settle();
      reset();
      if (open) openCommandPalette();
    };

    document.addEventListener("touchstart", onStart, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("touchmove", onMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("touchend", onEnd);
    document.addEventListener("touchcancel", onEnd);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", onStart);
      document.removeEventListener("touchmove", onMove);
      document.removeEventListener("touchend", onEnd);
      document.removeEventListener("touchcancel", onEnd);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={indicator}
      aria-hidden={!pulling}
      role="status"
      className={cn(
        "pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-0 z-20 flex h-10 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-full border pl-1.5 pr-4 text-detail font-medium shadow-lg lg:hidden",
        armed
          ? "border-primary bg-primary text-white"
          : "border-border bg-bg text-ink-secondary"
      )}
      style={{ opacity: 0, transform: "translate3d(-50%, -48px, 0) scale(0.85)" }}
    >
      <span className="relative flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center">
        <svg aria-hidden viewBox="0 0 36 36" className="absolute inset-0 h-7 w-7 -rotate-90">
          <circle cx="18" cy="18" r={RING_R} fill="none" strokeWidth="2.5" className={armed ? "stroke-white/30" : "stroke-border"} />
          <circle
            ref={ring}
            cx="18"
            cy="18"
            r={RING_R}
            fill="none"
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeDasharray={RING_C}
            strokeDashoffset={RING_C}
            className={cn("transition-[stroke] duration-150", armed ? "stroke-white" : "stroke-primary")}
          />
        </svg>
        <span className={cn("transition-transform duration-200", armed ? "scale-110" : "scale-100")}>
          <SearchIcon size={13} />
        </span>
      </span>
      {armed ? t.shell.releaseToSearch : t.shell.pullToSearch}
    </div>
  );
}
